# External works

Papers carrying observations relevant to the corpus but not themselves about grokking. The convention is in [`papers/README.md`](../papers/README.md), the section "External works (externals/)": a stored `original/` + an excerpt card (abstract, introduction, quoted paragraphs); these works take no part in the corpus's indexes and counters; mentions in the concept cards stand in the "External works" groups and carry the sign ↗.

## Register

The format of a line: `arxiv-id` · title · why it was drawn in · who in the corpus cites it · the date the citations were checked.

- `2110.06914` · What Happens after SGD Reaches Zero Loss? — A Mathematical Framework (Li, Wang & Arora, ICLR 2022) · the addressee of Mohamadi's genealogical claim about a pre-terminological observation of delayed generalization (the subsection "Earlier observations" in grokking.md) · 2311.18817, 2407.12332, 2505.20172 · 2026-08-24
